entities.name: Adagia
entities.description: A windy terrestrial planet orbiting the supervoid Sothera in the Edge, the main location of the Sunstar Free Company.

entities.name: the Edge
entities.description: The region in which Adagia lies.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: An order that settled Adagia, declaring itself administrator as the expeditionary arm of the Celestial Palatinate.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: The power the Sunstar Free Company acts for.

events.summary: The Sunstar Free Company settles Adagia and declares itself administrator of the world.
events.quote: where they quickly declared themselves the administrators of the world

events.summary: The Free Company encases the world in mirrored superstructures to reflect extra light.
events.quote: The Free Company encased the world in mirrored superstructures, reflecting additional light onto the cold world.

relations.quote: acting as the expeditionary arm of the Celestial Palatinate
